player_prompt.intro:
Wo ne Player {player_id} wɔ Connect Four.
Wo disc symbol: {symbol}.
Game board no wɔ {num_rows} safu ne {num_cols} column.
Players fa turns si wɔn disc mu baako wɔ column no mu (0 kosi {end_col}).
Onipa a edi kan a ɔbɛtɔ (ne nua) anan discs akyiri, ɔno na ɔdi nkunim.
Wo berɛ a wobɛyɛ move no, fa column number no wɔ squared brackets mu.
Sɛ nhwɛso: '[col 4]' anaa '[col 1]'.

board.board_notvisible_state: Agorɔ no ho nhyehyeɛ ntumi mma wɔn a wodi agoru no nhu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Player {player_id}, Nhyehyɛɛ akyi. Expected format: '[col x]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Player {player_id}, Nhyehyɛɛ akyi. Column {col} no wɔ hɔ.
invalid_move.already_full: Player {player_id}, Nhyehyɛɛ akyi. Column {col} no akyɛ.

action.dropped_disk: Player {player_id} si ne disk ({player_symbol}) wɔ column {col} mu.

outcome.win: Ɔbɔadeɛ {player_id} di nkonim denam anan a ɔde bɛka ho!
outcome.draw: Agoru no baa awiei sɛ nnipa biara nni agoro.
